title: French Gluten-Free Chicken Tarte Tatin
description: A gluten-free twist on the classic French dessert tarte tatin, featuring juicy chicken and a sweet, caramelized crust.

ingredients.name: all-purpose gluten-free flour
ingredients.notes: such as almond flour or coconut flour

ingredients.name: tarte tatin apples
ingredients.notes: such as Granny Smith or Golden Delicious

instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the gluten-free flour, sugar, and salt.
Add the softened butter to the bowl and mix until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Press the mixture into the bottom of a 9-inch round baking dish.
Arrange the chicken breast on top of the crust.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and vanilla extract.
Pour the egg mixture over the chicken breast.
Bake the tarte for 25-30 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the chicken is cooked through.
While the tarte is baking, prepare the tarte tatin apples by peeling, coring, and slicing them into thin wedges.
After the tarte has baked for 20-25 minutes, top it with the sliced apples and return it to the oven for an additional 5-10 minutes, or until the apples are caramelized and the crust is golden brown.
Remove the tarte from the oven and let it cool for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
